title: Animal picture cards for the sort, six cards
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: The human body and senses (Memory Box and Human Senses)
source: Seeded from science/y1 lesson 9 (Animal picture cards for the sort, six cards (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 9: Humans are mammals. To understand that humans are animals called mammals

blocks.title: Sort into: Fish / Bird / Mammal
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: Fish, Bird, Mammal.
blocks.answer: Fish: goldfish; salmon. Bird: robin; owl. Mammal: cat; horse

questions.model: I look at me. I have hair. I breathe air. I drank milk as a baby. So I am a mammal.

questions.q: Name one thing all mammals have.
questions.a: Hair or fur (or: breathe air, drink milk as babies)

questions.q: Draw a pet or a farm animal and yourself. Circle one thing that is the same.
questions.a: For example: both have eyes, or both have hair
questions.model: Teacher shows it first: I draw a cat and me. Both of us have two eyes. I circle the eyes.

questions.q: Write one thing that is different.
questions.a: For example: a cat has a tail, I do not

questions.q: Name a mammal that lives in the sea.
questions.a: A whale or a dolphin (or a seal)

questions.q: Big question: how are we like a cat, and how are we different?
questions.a: Same: hair, eyes, breathe air, babies drink milk. Different: two legs, no tail, we talk
